Reviewed Ubuntu 24.04 release Memory/Motherboard startup page with no inventory scan or fixture values; native screenshot equality is checked byte-for-byte below. Fixture values are synthetic, not hardware measurements. This is a sampled visual review, not a manual review of all 390 screenshots.

limits: Linux x86_64 packages; portable core tests do not establish Windows/macOS hardware support
